name: Sovereign Trust
source: CRON 20261014: Sovereign Trust Insurance Plc consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income for the period ended 30 June 2026, Group column Jun. 2026 (NGX doclib filing library), thousands of naira scaled to naira. Insurance revenue less insurance service expenses net of the net expenses from reinsurance equals the printed insurance service result exactly, which is stored as Gross Profit; that plus the printed investment return less the printed other operating expenses equals the printed subtotal, and less other finance costs equals the printed profit before income tax. Profit before income tax less the printed income tax expense equals the printed profit after income tax. EPS in naira per share from the printed figure. | Sovereign Trust Insurance Plc FY2025 financial highlights, statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, company column | Sovereign Trust Insurance Plc Annual Report FY2025, five-year financial summary, statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income (in thousands of naira); Revenue, Cost of Sales, Gross Profit and Operating Profit rescaled to thousands, the previous values were 1000x the filing

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored with a negative sign, which broke the printed identity Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT); the magnitude is unchanged and the column now carries the positive cost sign the identity requires

rows.label: EPS

unitGuard.reason: unit guard: the EPS row for FY2024 read 16.54 against 0.163069 for that period's net profit divided by the shares on file, a factor of 101.4, which is the 100x multiple of a per-share figure printed in a sub-unit (kobo / cents / a thousandth). Normalised to 0.1654, the unit the price is quoted in.

rows.unitGuardBasis: factor = stored EPS / (the same period's net profit / shares on file); a factor within 15% of a power of ten (or its reciprocal) whose corrected value lands within 2.0x of the triangle is a UNIT error and is normalised; a stored cell of the opposite sign to the period's net profit whose magnitude is beyond 5.0x is WITHHELD with both figures named; every other cell is left exactly as filed

rows.label: Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.derivedFormula: Operating Profit (EBIT) = Gross Profit - Operating Expenses
rows.identityAgreement: 3869 agree / 392 contradict globally, self-checked inside this file
rows.derivedCellFormula: Operating Profit (EBIT) = Gross Profit - Operating Expenses, applied only to a file whose own filed EBIT periods all agree with it

derivation.ebitNote: EBIT periods tagged derived are arithmetic on this security's own gross profit and operating expenses
